Investment — Edit

The Investment form allows you to create new investment records or modify existing ones in your portfolio.

Use this form to record details about your stocks, bonds, mutual funds, exchange-traded funds (ETFs), and other financial instruments.

Key Information

Each investment record maintains important information such as the investment name, number of units held, and current market value.

The system automatically calculates your investment position based on the number of units and their market price.

Tracking Performance

You can track both realized and unrealized gains or losses by updating market prices regularly.

Realized gains occur when you sell investments, while unrealized gains reflect changes in market value for investments you still hold.

Code

Enter a code or ticker symbol for this investment. This provides a short identifier for reports and transactions.

Name

Enter the full name or description of this investment, such as company name or fund description.

Control account

Select a control account if you want to group this investment with others for reporting purposes.

Inactive

Check this box to deactivate the investment. Inactive investments won't appear in selection lists but retain their history.
